title: Works great! I love it!
text: Works great! I love it!. Really comfortable, arrived in great shape and condition very clean. The only thing I did not like is that it's a bit bigger than I expected so I have no idea where to store it but other than that it's perfect I like it a lot. I like working on my computer and tablets in bed and this really helps my back particularly when I want to be sitting or rest my head cause it can be really uncomfortable without it.

product_metadata.title: Cheer Collection Kids Size Pillow with Arms for Sitting up in Bed, Reading, Gaming, Watching - Taupe
features: SUPER COMFORTABLE - Generously filled with firm shredded memory foam and encased in a soft velour fabric to make your reading, gaming or watching experience extremely comfy
ERGONOMIC DESIGN - Sitting pillow molds to fit to your child's body shape and provides excellent support for arms, back, and shoulders
VERSATILE - Great for reading while sitting up in bed, homework, gaming or watching TV on a bed, couch or on the floor; Perfect for kids who love to read and relax
CONVENIENT - Sturdy top handle and lightweight design allow for easy transport. Great for studying and doing homework

WASHABLE COVER - Removable zippered cover can be machine washed unlike other reading pillows that can only be spot washed. PILLOW IS COMPRESSED FOR SHIPPING PURPOSES. PLEASE ALLOW 24 HOURS AFTER OPENING TO REGAIN ITS FULL LOFT
description: Reading pillow, TV Pillow, Sitting Pillow, Armrest Pillow, Backrest Pillow - whatever you call it, your kids will love relaxing while sitting up in bed with this luscious pillow. Your child can settle in for a good book or a favorite movie with extra back support and plush comfort. There's nothing quite like settling into a kids reading Pillow on a bed, floor, or couch. The Cheer Collection children's TV and reading pillow lets your child relax and read while supporting them in ultra comfort. Its support will help children avoid slouching by maintainig correct back and neck posture, making their overall gaming, watching or reading experience much more comfortable and enjoyable. It is durable, yet lightweight and easy to move from room to room or even take with you on trips. The pillow is filled with 1800 grams of shredded memory foam for just the right amount of comfort and support as your child rests. Dimensions: 16“ (L) x 13“ (W) x 16“ (H); Product Weight: 4.5 lbs. Includes removable zippered cover for easy washing.
